title: Ticket Listing Pagination
description: A ticket list endpoint returns wrong pages, wrong totals and unexpected ordering. Find the bugs from the contract in the README.

phases.title: Bug Fix
phases.prompt: Using the contract in README.md, trace listTickets({ status: 'open', sortBy: 'priority', direction: 'desc', page: 1, pageSize: 3 }) by hand. Identify every place the output violates the contract (filtering, ordering, pagination).

phases.title: Implement
phases.prompt: Add cursor-based pagination: listTicketsAfter({ after, limit }) returning { items, nextCursor }. Cursors must stay stable when new tickets are created between requests.

phases.title: Optimize
phases.prompt: Every request filters and sorts the whole array. Give the complexity, then propose an index or precomputed ordering that makes status filtering and first-page requests cheaper. State the trade-offs.
